subject: springboot
question: What is the minimum Java version required by Spring Boot 3?
explanation: Spring Boot 3 and Spring Framework 6 require Java 17 as a baseline.

subject: springboot
question: Which Maven goal builds an OCI container image using Cloud Native Buildpacks?
explanation: build-image uses Buildpacks to create an OCI image without a Dockerfile.

subject: springboot
question: Which Maven command runs a Spring Boot application from source?
explanation: The spring-boot:run goal compiles and starts the application in place.

subject: springboot
question: What does the spring-boot-maven-plugin repackage goal produce?
options: A WAR file for external application servers only
An executable jar that nests all dependency jars
explanation: repackage rewrites the jar into an executable fat jar runnable with java -jar.

subject: springboot
question: Why do Spring Boot layered jars help when building Docker images?
options: They compress the jar to half its size
They remove the need for a JVM in the image
Dependencies and application classes go in separate layers, so unchanged layers are cached
They encrypt application classes inside the image
explanation: Rarely changing dependencies end up in lower layers, so rebuilding after a code change only replaces the application layer.

subject: springboot
question: What must a Spring Boot app do to be deployed as a WAR to an external Tomcat?
options: Remove the main method and add web.xml only
Extend SpringBootServletInitializer and use war packaging with the Tomcat starter set to provided
explanation: SpringBootServletInitializer bootstraps the application when the servlet container starts the WAR.

subject: springboot
question: Which Spring Boot 3 capability uses AOT processing to compile an app into a standalone native executable?
explanation: Boot 3 performs ahead-of-time processing so GraalVM can build a native executable with fast startup.

subject: springboot
question: Which property configures graceful shutdown of the embedded web server?
explanation: With graceful shutdown the server stops accepting requests and waits for active ones, bounded by spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase.

subject: springboot
question: Why can't you switch @Profile-based beans at runtime in a Spring Boot GraalVM native image?
options: Native images cannot read environment variables
Profiles are only supported in WAR deployments
AOT processing fixes the bean definitions at build time
explanation: Native images assume a closed world, so profiles and conditions are evaluated during the AOT build.

subject: springboot
question: In an executable Spring Boot jar, what does the manifest's Main-Class point to?
options: Spring Boot's JarLauncher, with Start-Class naming your application class
explanation: The launcher sets up a class loader for the nested jars and then invokes Start-Class.

subject: springboot
question: With spring-boot-starter-parent, how do you usually override the managed version of Jackson?
options: Set the jackson-bom.version property in the pom
explanation: The parent manages versions through properties, so redefining one changes the version used.

subject: springboot
question: Why does spring-boot-devtools not affect an app started with java -jar from a packaged jar?
options: Devtools turns itself off when the app runs as a fully packaged application
explanation: Devtools treats a packaged launch as production and disables itself; repackage also excludes it by default.
